variants.no_rasch: Set eta_n to zero; retain metadata smoothing, kernel mixing, and topic correction
variants.no_kernel: Set w_n to zero; use the Rasch hybrid and the unchanged topic correction at every budget
variants.no_topic: Set Delta_n(i) to zero; retain both prediction branches and their released mixing weights

protocol.evidence: Replay the published adaptive acquisition prefixes; identical support and evaluation items for every variant
protocol.fitting: Inference-time component removal only; no refitting or retuning, including calibration
protocol.aggregation: Mean squared error within each group, equal group means within each seed, equal seed means; official six-budget ALC weights
protocol.validation: Full ASRP must reproduce every published adaptive prediction within 1e-7; component calculations are also checked against native predict with the corresponding component disabled
